_comment: Recipes of the stage-2 movie planning office (room 22), prefix planning.

Movie records: 10 x 0x344 bytes at 0x455aa1, count 0x457b49. +0 title (the planning code keeps a copy of all 10 titles at 0x483e2c + 100*i), +0x100 storyline index (string 604 + index), +0x104 movie category (0 family, 50 soft, 100 hardcore; 100 in a fresh record), +0x108 scene list (12 dwords, -1 = empty), +0x148 length in minutes (10 per scene), +0x14c state (0 in planning, 1 planning finished), +0x150 basic price per 10 minutes (1000 in a fresh record), +0x154 total basic price (scenes * price, deducted when planning is concluded).

Room 22 work copy of the current movie at 0x45d5f8 (same layout), current movie index 0x483e24, sheet title count 0x45d93c. Staff counts at setup (0x41f4d7): production designer (job 10) 0x484228, production assistant (job 9) 0x48422c, screenplay writer (job 3) 0x484230, all three present 0x484224. A count above 1 sets 0x4555f4, which draws the staff icon at 40,380 (click hotspot 0xff).
Staff table: record i at SAVEGAME file offset 0x7b8d + 40*i, written as the pseudo address 0x45d1ad + 40*i (+0 job, +4 status: 0 free, 1 hired and idle, 2 hired and working).

planning_s2.note: prod_s2staff (all production buildings rented, one employee per job: writer 208, production assistant 323 and production designer 343 working, actor 527 and actress 17 hired, account 1500000, 8:00, WET plot) with a slow clock (0x4556bc = 30, 31 timer calls per game minute instead of 4), so no hourly event (10:00 department reports, 13:00 sabotage roll 0x43070e) interrupts the planning scripts. Name and Load-dialog entry stay 'ProdAll' (300,119).

planning_movie.note: planning_s2 after the game planned one screenplay in room 22 (script planning_movie.txt): Write screenplay -> New -> title 'Lust in Space' -> Pick storyline -> 'Sex Hackers' (list entry 3, string 607) -> thumbs up; Define the subject of the movie -> 'Soft' -> thumbs up; back to the WET plot and saved as 'Planned' in slot 4 (Load-dialog entry 300,119). Clock patched back to 8:00 and the minute countdown 0x4556c0 to 0 (the only byte that differed between two builds). The check asserts movie count 1, the title's first dword ('Lust'), storyline 3, category 50, state 0, no scenes, basic price 1000 per 10 minutes and the untouched account.

planning_writers.note: planning_s2 with a second screenplay writer and no production designer: writer 212 (job 3, level 6, 300 $ a day) hired and idle (status +4 = 1, what the hire code 0x41c9ad gives the second employee of a job) and designer 343 back to free (status 0), patched at the pseudo addresses 0x45d1ad + 40*i + 4. Room 22 setup (0x41f4d7) then counts 2 writers in 0x484230 and no designer in 0x484228; the count above 1 sets 0x4555f4, so the staff icon at 40,380 is drawn and clicking it gives hotspot 0xff (0x40423f), which opens the 'Assign staff' sheet (DDF 57, callback 0x41f574). Name and Load-dialog entry stay 'ProdAll' (300,119).

planning_done.note: planning_movie after the game finished the planning of movie 0 (script planning_done.txt): Work on storyboard -> film strip pictures 0, 1, 2 (3000 $) -> Conclude planning -> yes; back to the WET plot and saved as 'Finished' in slot 4 (Load-dialog entry 300,119). Clock patched back to 8:00 and the minute countdown 0x4556c0 to 0 (the only byte that differed between two builds). The check asserts state 1 (+0x14c), scenes 0, 1, 2 (+0x108), 30 minutes (+0x148), total basic price 3000 (+0x154) and the account 1500000 - 3000.

planning_cast.note: planning_done with actor 527 and actress 17 (both hired and idle in prod_s2staff) patched into the cast of movie 0: cast list +0x1b4 (0x455c55) = 527, 17 and cast count +0x2f4 (0x455d95) = 2. Firing an actor (casting office, Look at actors file, card control 5, 0x41b3b2) calls 0x41dd79, which removes the person from the cast of every movie. Name and Load-dialog entry stay 'Finished' (300,119).

planning_short.note: planning_movie (movie 0 'Lust in Space' in planning) without a screenplay writer: writer 208 back to free (status +4 = 0 at the pseudo address 0x45d1ad + 40*208 + 4). Room 22 setup (0x41f4d7) then leaves 0x484230 = 0 and 0x484224 = 0, so the storyboard still opens (designer) but Conclude planning answers 'You can't finish planning until you've hired all your staff!'. Name and Load-dialog entry stay 'Planned' (300,119).

planning_poor.note: planning_movie with 9 movie records in use (count 0x457b49 = 9; records 1-8 stay blank) and the account at -69500 (with the credit line 0x455684 = 70000 only 500 $ can be spent, 0x40561d). 'New' in the screenplay sheet then refuses a tenth title (string 602, count >= 9 at 0x41e500) and the first storyboard scene (1000 $) answers 'Unfortunately you haven't got enough money!'. Name and Load-dialog entry stay 'Planned' (300,119).
